attchmntText: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board met on November 14, 2026. The company reported a loss of 252.94 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the loss was 646.11 million rupees. Revenue from operations was 1681.86 million rupees for the quarter. Total income was 1812.07 million rupees. The company incurred exceptional items of 356.92 million rupees in the quarter. This includes forfeiture of security deposits related to two railway contracts. The company has filed writ petitions in the Rajasthan High Court against the North Western Railway. Management expects to succeed in these proceedings. The statutory auditors expressed an unqualified opinion on the results.

attchmntText: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification on declaration/confirmation given under Notice of Annual General Meeting'.
Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Business update regarding MOU for proposed acquisition of N.K. Gupta Builders Private Limited'.
